summary.en: A page builds itself on a blueprint board: a line crosses it and each block flies in and snaps into its slot as the line passes; variant type docks bare shells first, then every character tumbles in through depth.
summary.zh: 页面在蓝图画板上自己长出来：扫描线掠过，扫到哪个槽位，那块就从画外飞入过冲贴合并被角标咬住；变体 type 先让无字骨架落位，再让每个字从纵深翻滚落定。

fits: A product that generates or builds a page (sites, apps, documents): the result assembling itself in seconds.
notFor: Products whose output is not a page; layouts the film must show in its real proportions (the board is fixed to seven blocks).

overlaps.note: the same line reading a page that exists; blueprint-build builds the page as the line passes
cells landing into a grid; blueprint-build lands a page's blocks into a blueprint
titles entering unit by unit; the type variant tumbles every character through depth (proposed as type-enter tumble)

intent.en: The page builds itself in seconds, so the viewer feels the product generate the result, not draw it by hand.
intent.zh: 页面几秒内自己长出来，让观众感到结果是产品生成的，不是手画的。

content.en: A landing-page set: headline ≤ 24 chars, body ≤ 70 chars, badge, three nav items, two buttons, three stats (value + label), an optional picture; seven slot tags and three status words.
content.zh: 一套落地页内容：标题 ≤ 10 字、正文 ≤ 26 字、徽章、三个导航项、两个按钮、三项数据（数值加标签）、可选配图；七个槽位标签和三个状态词。

fits.zh: 生成或搭建页面的产品（网站、应用、文档）：结果几秒内自己装配起来。

notFor.zh: 产出不是页面的产品；必须按真实比例展示的版式（画板固定七块）。

pairs.note: build the page, then read it back

en: Seven blocks on a fixed board: a page with another structure needs its own scene, not squeezed copy.
The type variant's characters are unreadable while they tumble; the page reads only after frame 128.
zh: 画板固定七块：结构不同的页面要另做场景，不要硬塞文字。
type 变体翻滚中的字读不了；第 128 帧以后页面才可读。

upstream.name: 扫描装配飞入
upstream.summary: 页面开场是一张只有网格与虚线槽位的蓝图画板，一条亮扫描线自上而下掠过；扫到每个槽位，该处组件就从画外飞入过冲贴合，带方向性残影模糊与落位咬合角标——扫完整页恰好装配完成
upstream.use: "页面自己生成"的开场；AI 建站/自动排版类产品的核心演示；从空白到成品的能力叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（扫描线是稳的，但每次组件飞入都是一个爆点，密度递进）

upstream.name: 骨架装配落字
upstream.summary: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
upstream.use: 页面/海报"自己长出来"的开场；排版类产品的能力展示；从骨架到成稿的两段式叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（骨架段稀疏、文字段密集，能量单调上升到收尾）
